settings.text: Six dog care kits. One job each. Less than buying the pieces apart.
All of them live inside a kit too.
Puppy to senior, gear that holds up.
4 or 5 essentials per kit, in colorways you pick. Save $11.95 to $26.95.
Built for the dog who flinches at clippers and the senior who takes a run-up to stand. Every product earned its place.

Orders are processed in 1 to 3 business days, then typically arrive in 5 to 12 business days within the US. Tracking is emailed the moment your parcel ships. We ship direct rather than paying for domestic warehousing, which keeps prices down, and we would rather say so plainly than surprise you at checkout.

settings.heading: Which kit should I start with?

settings.text: Match it to the job in front of you. New Puppy covers the first month: crate, teething, teeth and first walks. Grooming Essentials is a full home session, coat to nails to teeth. Calm & Comfort is for storms, fireworks and being left alone. Enrichment slows down dinner and gives a bored dog a job. Travel is the bag by the door, and the Toy Kit is five different games rather than five versions of the same one. Every kit costs less than buying its pieces separately.

settings.heading: What if it is not right?

settings.text: You have 30 days from delivery. If it arrived faulty, damaged, or wrong, we cover return shipping and send a replacement or full refund, your choice. Changed your mind is fine too; return shipping is on you in that case.

settings.heading: Do the kits actually save money?

settings.text: Yes. Each kit is priced below the combined cost of its items: the saving runs from $11.95 to $26.95 depending on the kit, and the exact figure is shown on each kit's own page. It also arrives as one parcel rather than several.
